name: dbt-sqlite-playground
description: A simple playground for dbt with the sqlite connector

paragraphs: Last week I was taking the free dbt Fundamentals course offered by dbt labs, and the only options to take it "easily" are using cloud data warehouses, or starting a Postgres/MySQL/some-db container or application locally. I didn't want the hassle, or more like, I wanted to configure the dbt parts in the easiest way possible.
Sadly, for a lot of dbt things you can't really use sqlite, ¯\(ツ)/¯
All commands are defined in a taskfile to make my life easier.
features: Technically, a Poetry project, containing helper tools (including dbt via dbt-sqlite);
A small (and somewhat dirty) Python script (populate.py) to place some not-very-fancy data in a Sqlite file. It will always delete it on load;
A dbt project with sources (based on this pre-populated data) and models. Includes some tests, too.
